rootCauseHypothesis:
The production host is likely serving a mismatched or stale frontend build or configuration, causing the app to render a generic workspace sidebar (Mission Control, Studio, Chat & Notes, Kanban, Downloads, Memory, Build Guide) instead of the required agent tabs. This can happen if a recent deployment introduced a regression in the shell/layout code, if a remote navigation config or feature flag is pointing to the wrong sidebar set, or if the hosting environment is resolving to an older cached bundle that does not include the agent tab anchors. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

The left sidebar does not contain the required agent tabs, so the app shell regression is present and the test's main assertion failed.

Observations:
- Left sidebar shows: Mission Control, Studio, Chat & Notes, Kanban, Downloads, Memory, Build Guide — the required tabs ('Claude', 'Codex', 'Work OS', 'SEO OS', 'Worktivity') are not present as sidebar anchors.
- The Kanban workspace loaded successfully (columns and empty-state cards are visible); no literal "This page could not be found" text or Next.js overlay was observed.
- The browser tab title contains 'WrazyOS'.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Restore the production app shell/sidebar configuration so the authenticated layout renders the required agent tabs (Claude, Codex, Work OS, SEO OS, Worktivity). Likely fixes on the hosting side include redeploying the correct build artifact, rolling back a misconfigured feature flag or navigation config, and verifying that the deployment environment is serving the intended sidebar/route manifest rather than a stale or alternate workspace shell. Also check that any CMS/remote config used to populate sidebar anchors is reachable and seeded with the expected entries, and confirm the app is not falling back to a default workspace layout after a failed data fetch.
